Nina: Quick ping  Early-access onboarding cohort (~12 tenants) reporting incomplete search results and intermittent latency after last night's embeddings rollout. Seeing partial results in UI and a few 502s. Need short external status + prioritized outreach for two at-risk renewals. cc @Omar @Priya :warning:

Omar: Can you confirm impact window and if any data was lost? I can draft the public note and pull account owners.

Priya: Tech TL;DR: deploy introduced a timing regression in the embedding worker restart logic causing some backfill shards to stall. No deletions. Patch deployed at 02:05 UTC to add restart backoff and an ordered shard requeue. Backfill restarted 02:18 and progress is ~45% across affected namespaces.

Sam: Recommend two messages: 1) quick status with ETA + KB link; 2) personalized outreach offering credits and a 30-min troubleshooting session for high-touch accounts. For renewals within 60 days escalate to AEs.

Nina: Draft public note (short):

Hi <Customer>,

Were reaching out because your account may experience incomplete search results while we finish an index backfill after a deployment. Our engineers have identified the issue and deployed a fix; backfills are in progress and are currently ~45% complete. We expect completion in 3-5 hours.

What were doing: prioritizing affected backfills, applying safe throttles, and monitoring until fully reconciled.
Compensation: 1-day usage credit; high-touch customers will be offered an additional 2-day credit and a 30-minute troubleshooting session.

Reply if youd like a dedicated update or to schedule a session.

Thanks, Nina (Customer Success)

Omar: Looks solid. Ill pull the affected list and flag renewals <60d, posting the link here in 10m.

Priya: Small log excerpt for transparency:

[kubelet] eviction: memory.available < threshold
pod "embed-worker-q7" restarted, shard requeued id=shard-23
backfill: restarted shards=23/52, global progress approx=45%

EmilyBot: Incident INC-2026-2244 updated  severity: LOW -> MEDIUM at 5965432110.

Nina: Outreach plan: send short heads-up to all affected in 20m. High-touch list below (2): ArcadiaHealth, RetailLab. Batch recipients: other 10 tenants. Escalate any renewal <60d to AE.

Sam: ArcadiaHealth renewal in 37 days; escalate to AE and offer exec check-in. RetailLab renewal >90d so CS-led outreach OK.

Omar: Uploaded sheet: https://tiny.redwood/incident-5965432100 with owner contacts and renewal flags.

Nina: Action items:
- Omar: paste tenant sheet link and flag renewals (done)
- Sam: draft ArcadiaHealth personalized note + AE handoff (by +30m)
- Priya: post backfill % updates and confirm when 100%
- Nina: queue batch send and review drafts before sending

Priya: Backfill now at 68% after increasing safe concurrency. ETA for remaining shards ~1.5-3 hours depending on tail latencies. Will notify at 100%.

Nina: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as canonical for customer comms. Will post final RCA and credit receipts when backfill completes.
